name: Free AI YouTube Shorts Generator (Gemini Pro, Pexels and JSON2Video)

parameters.content:
## ⚙️ Setup — 3 FREE API keys (koi credit card nahi)

1. **GEMINI_API_KEY** → free key: [aistudio.google.com/apikey](https://aistudio.google.com/apikey)
   - Default model `gemini-2.5-pro` hai (Google ka Pro model, free tier mein)
   - Agar "rate limit / 429" aaye to `GEMINI_MODEL` ko `gemini-2.5-flash` kar do
2. **PEXELS_API_KEY** → free key: [pexels.com/api](https://www.pexels.com/api/) (background stock videos ke liye)
3. **JSON2VIDEO_API_KEY** → free key: [json2video.com/get-api-key](https://json2video.com/get-api-key/) (video render + Hindi voice + subtitles)
4. **6. Upload to YouTube** node par apni **YouTube OAuth2** credential lagao (n8n mein Google/YouTube OAuth setup — free)

🎙️ **Voice badalna hai?** `VOICE` field mein dusra Hindi voice daalo — `hi-IN-SwaraNeural` (female), `hi-IN-KunalNeural`, `hi-IN-AnanyaNeural` (female). English videos ke liye `en-US-EmmaMultilingualNeural` + `LANGUAGE` ko `English` kar do.

## 🎬 Kaise chalta hai (100% FREE stack)

**TOPIC do → Short video YouTube par upload:**

1. **Gemini 2.5 Pro** (free tier) pura script banata hai — title, description, tags + 4 scenes (hook, voiceover, footage idea)
2. **Pexels** (free) har scene ke liye vertical stock video dhoondta hai
3. **JSON2Video** (free plan) video render karta hai — footage + hook text + **Hindi voiceover** + **auto subtitles** (1080×1920 vertical)
4. n8n render complete hone tak wait karta hai (20 sec loop), MP4 download karke **YouTube par private upload** karta hai

⚠️ **Free plan limits:**
- JSON2Video free: **600 seconds/month** (≈ 10–12 Shorts) + chhota watermark
- Gemini free tier: per-day request limits (manual runs ke liye kaafi hai)
- Video **private** upload hoti hai — review karke khud public karo

💡 Ye template paid tools (ElevenLabs, Creatomate) ke bina kaam karta hai. Google ka Pro model script ke liye free hai, lekin Google ka video/image generation (Veo, Nano Banana) paid hai — isliye visuals free Pexels stock se aate hain.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ contents: [{ parts: [{ text: 'You are an expert YouTube Shorts scriptwriter for Indian audiences. Topic: ' + $json.TOPIC + '. Voiceover language: ' + $json.LANGUAGE + '. Return ONLY a valid JSON object with exactly these keys: "title" (catchy English title under 90 chars), "description" (2 short lines plus exactly 5 hashtags, English and Hindi mix), "tags" (comma separated, 8-12 SEO tags), "scenes" (exactly 4 items, each with: "hook" = 3-6 word ALL CAPS on-screen caption in English or Hinglish, "voiceover" = 1-2 natural spoken sentences in the voiceover language (if Hindi, write in Devanagari script), "pexels_query" = 2-3 simple English words for searching stock footage, e.g. "indian temple aerial")).' }] }], generationConfig: { responseMimeType: 'application/json' } }) }}
